mutants.description: Computes exponential delay but never applies the configured cap.
Computes and caps exponential delay but accepts zero and fractional attempts.
mutants.patch:
diff --git a/src/retry-delay.mjs b/src/retry-delay.mjs
--- a/src/retry-delay.mjs
+++ b/src/retry-delay.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 export function retryDelay(attempt, baseMs, capMs) {
-  return Math.min(capMs, baseMs * attempt)
+  return Math.min(capMs, baseMs * 2 ** (attempt - 1))
 }
